Name: FastGrass
Author: Stitch1959
Description:
[b]OVERVIEW[/b]
Vanilla grass spreads slowly and stays thin, so feeding animals from your own farm means waiting days for it to recover. This mod runs several extra spread passes every morning and can keep every tile at full thickness.

[b]WHAT IT DOES[/b]
• Runs up to ten spread passes each morning, so new grass appears much faster.
• Lock maximum thickness, so existing and new grass is pushed to four layers every morning.
• Daily cap, a hard limit on how many new tiles may appear per morning, so the farm is not swallowed overnight.
• Safe tile rules by default, no water, no buildings, no occupied tiles and no tiles where grass cannot spawn.
• Optional winter growth, off by default to match vanilla behaviour.
• Optional daily console line with the number of new tiles.

[b]SETTINGS[/b]
Install Generic Mod Config Menu to change any of these in game.

• Enabled, turns all accelerated growth off.
• Spread rounds per day, 1 to 10. Each round, every grass tile tries to grow one tile further out.
• Lock maximum thickness, pushes all grass to four layers every morning.
• Max new tiles per day, 0 means unlimited.
• Only on plantable soil, keeps grass off porches, decorative stone, water edges and building footprints.
• Grow in winter, off by default.
• Daily log, one console line each morning.

[b]COMPATIBILITY[/b]
• Multiplayer, only the host runs the spread, so farms do not double up.
• Save data, no custom save data is stored, so you can remove the mod at any time.
• Languages, English, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish and Simplified Chinese.

[b]REQUIREMENTS[/b]
• SMAPI 4.0.0 or later, tested with 4.5.2, game version 1.6.15.
• Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.
